map.三种脑膜炎鉴别要点: Key Differentiation of the Three Meningitides
map.脑脊液鉴别需综合判断：化脓性\"高蛋白、低糖、多核为主\"；结核性\"低糖低氯、: CSF differentiation needs synthesis: purulent shows 'high protein, low glucose, mostly polymorphs'; tuberculous shows 'low glucose/low chloride, mostly lymphocytes, moderate protein rise'; viral shows 'normal glucose, mostly lymphocytes, mild protein rise'. Final diagnosis needs microbiology (smear/culture/PCR) and clinical picture.

map.中性粒细胞高、糖明显降低、蛋白高提示化脓性；淋巴高、糖近正常更倾向病毒性；需结合: High neutrophils, markedly low glucose and high protein suggest purulent; high lymphocytes and near-normal glucose lean viral; correlate with smear and culture.

map.脑脊液常规对照工具。按压力/细胞/蛋白/糖氯区间提示常见模式；仅供复核。: A CSF routine reference tool. Flags common patterns by pressure/cells/protein/glucose-chloride ranges; for review only.
map.综合加权评分：对化脓/结核/病毒三类分别累加多参数权重分（外观、压力、WBC、多: Comprehensive weighted score: for the purulent / tuberculous / viral categories, accumulate multi-parameter weighted points (appearance, pressure, WBC, polymorph %, protein, glucose, chloride). CSF/blood glucose ratio = CSF glucose ÷ blood glucose; match = top category score ÷ total score across the three categories × 100%. Key weights: purulent appearance +3 purulent; WBC > 1000 +3 purulent; polymorphs > 60% +3 purulent; glucose < 1.0 +3 purulent; ground-glass appearance / lymphocyte predominance (polymorphs < 40%) / chloride < 110 favors tuberculosis; normal items score nothing, and a pathogen tendency is output only when ≥2 items are abnormal (the match denominator includes only abnormal-item scores).
map.请至少填写白细胞计数与蛋白定量（其余项可留空）；空值不会被当作 0 参与评分。: Enter at least WBC and protein (other fields may be left blank); empty values are never scored as 0.
map.鉴别结果为辅助参考（本页按成人 CSF 常用参考区间做启发式评分，属本页估算），: Differentiation is an adjunct only (this page applies heuristic scoring based on common adult CSF reference intervals; an estimate). Confirmation requires microbiology (Gram stain, acid-fast stain, culture, PCR) and clinical synthesis, with clinical review.
